span.p:
Add ordinary ticket options: type,
number of tickets, price and sales window

div.style: color: rgb(74, 4, 78) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Add a wave: name,
start date and end date

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Check the wave doesn't overlap
the category's other waves

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(74, 4, 78) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Add the wave's ticket options:
type, number of tickets and price

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Check that all ticket options together,
public and set aside, stay within
the event's capacity

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Save the wave; its options take
the wave's dates as their sales window

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
End: publish the event
when it's ready

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Start: a wave has ended
with tickets unsold

div.style: color: rgb(74, 4, 78) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Choose the ended option, a later wave's
option in the same category, and how many
tickets to move

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Lower the ended option's capacity:
UPDATE … WHERE capacity - sold_count
- reserved_count >= :n

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Raise the later option's capacity,
record the move in the audit log
and commit

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Roll back: fewer unsold tickets
than requested

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
End: the tickets go on sale
with the later wave

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
